input.question: Why did the military claim that a a flying saucer crashed at Roswell?
input.ground_truth: According to the US government narrative, a rancher [ran across some classified programs](_URL_0_). And it all got out of hand because a local US Air Force press officer saw some stuff he shouldn't have and reported it as flying saucer debris. There are some pretty questionable issues with that story, and 60 years of a theoretical ecosystem centered around Roswell and UFOs and aliens, but that was the official line.
